exposure: factors affecting ascertainment of cause of death
cohort: The study included all women delivering at Hospital Nacional Guido Valadares (HNGV) in Timor-Leste from January to June 2016, whose babies experienced a perinatal death.
finding: The study found limited improvement in perinatal mortality rates at HNGV, with intrapartum hypoxia and maternal hypertensive conditions identified as the commonest aetiologies for intrapartum and early neonatal deaths.
followup_time: up to 7 days after birth (for early neonatal deaths)
